import.title: Import PeerTube Video
import.importDescription: Choose how you want to add a video to your library.
import.guideDescription: Follow these steps to prepare a PeerTube video so you can import and search it in NoeticSearch.
import.guideStep1: 1. Open your PeerTube instance in a new tab and navigate to the video you want to import.
import.guideStep2: 2. Copy the full video URL from your browser address bar (it should start with https://).
import.guideStep3: 3. Paste the URL into the field on the left and wait for the green checkmark to confirm it can be imported.
import.searchGuideDescription: Use the PeerTube search on the left to find a public video you want to import into NoeticSearch.
import.searchGuideStep1: 1. Choose a PeerTube instance, or keep the default one if it already looks correct.
import.searchGuideStep2: 2. Enter a video title or keywords in the search box and run the search to see matching videos.
import.searchGuideStep3: 3. Click a result to preview it here and continue the import.

hero.title: Search inside
hero.subtitle: any video.
hero.description: Find exact quotes, terms, and references across video transcripts with precision.
hero.whatIsDescription: An application to perform keyword searches across one or more digital audiovisual documents. The application can generate video transcripts, search terms and references in those transcripts with precision, and extract citations from them.
hero.howToStep1: Go to a PeerTube instance, choose a video, and copy its link.
hero.howToStep2: Click "Import a video" and paste the video link.
hero.howToStep3: Then go to "Generate the video transcript", search for keywords in the video, and extract exact citations from the video.
hero.howToStep4: You can also run searches across multiple videos, using all the videos you have imported.
hero.tutorialDescription: Watch a quick walkthrough of how to search inside your imported videos.
hero.tutorialSectionTitle: Want to learn more or running into difficulties?
hero.corpusTutorialTitle: How to add new corpus videos
hero.corpusTutorialDescription: Learn how to import new PeerTube videos into your corpus so they become searchable inside NoeticSearch.

about.title: Search inside
about.subtitle: every video.
about.description: NoeticSearch is a video transcript search platform. Import PeerTube videos, query their subtitles with AI, and find exact quotes across your library.
about.feature1Description: We support PeerTube, the federated open-source video platform. Import any public video and make your searches discoverable by the community.
about.feature2Description: Your search history and library are private by default. Share only what you explicitly choose to make public.
about.feature3Description: Our assistant understands natural-language queries and finds the most relevant transcript segments across your entire library.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Policy.
privacy.collectContent: We collect the minimum data needed to provide the service:
privacy.collectItem1: Email address and display name (account creation)
privacy.collectItem2: Videos you import and their associated metadata and transcripts
privacy.useContent: Your data is used solely to operate NoeticSearch. We do not sell, share, or monetize your personal information with third parties.
privacy.visibilityContent: All searches and videos are private by default. You may choose to mark them as public, which makes them visible to other users and on the home page.
privacy.deletionContent: You can delete individual searches, imported videos, or your entire account at any time from the Settings page. Deletion is permanent and immediate.
privacy.contactContent: For privacy-related questions or data requests, reach out to privacy@noeticsearch.com.
